comparison.objective: PR-1520 joins two furniture panels using two cam-and-bolt locks; the candidate adjusts a gripper stop screw and locks its jam nut.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1520 tests cam orientation, panel-to-multiple-fastener alignment, panel seating, and separate screwdriver turns; the candidate requires concentric two-tool counterholding on one coupled adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1520 requires both bolts captured, cams locked, joint gap closed, and tools returned; the candidate requires retained 90° motion over three cycles with bounded drift.
comparison.reason: Both use threaded-tool primitives, but panel assembly with eccentric cams lacks the candidate's simultaneous setting-preservation and functional-cycle test.
